exercises.passage:
There are three common questions about how to improve our English.

The first question is about real English. Some students say that they want to learn real English. But they don't know what to do. Watching English films is a good way. When we are tired after studying for a long time, we can watch an English film to relax. While watching it, we can also learn real English at the same time.

The second question is about speaking. Most students feel too shy to talk with foreigners. "Where are you from?" "What do you think of China?" These are both good questions to start a conversation. Before we begin, take a deep breath and smile! Smiling always helps.

The third question is about vocabulary. We want to remember all the new words. The problem is that we write them down but forget them soon. Write eight or ten words on a piece of paper and put it in our bedroom. Try to remember them. Spell the words whenever we see them, and change them every day. There is another way. When you're shopping, count the English words or say the English names for everything you see as much as possible.

exercises.passage:
Learning Chinese is a challenging but good experience as it gives you the opportunity to communicate with more than a billion people.

Foreigners think Chinese is a mysterious and difficult language because it is very different from the Roman alphabet (罗马字母表). In fact, Chinese is not much more difficult than any other language. One reason is that Chinese does not have the kind of complex tenses (复杂的时态) like European languages.

Although it is certainly not easy for foreigners, in my experience you can learn Chinese fast. You will certainly find differences between the language in textbooks and people's everyday speech. One example of this is the difference between language on the street and written Chinese. It produces new phrases and vocabulary. In real life nowadays, people often use short, less conversational phrases to communicate with each other. China has many provinces (省份) and their ______ are different.

After you learn and understand the Beijing dialect, you may find it hard to understand the Shanghai dialect. The language continues developing. So it is still not easy for learners, no matter how well they learn from textbooks.

I hope that one day more Chinese courses will be able to connect with "real" spoken Chinese and the way in which Chinese people speak daily. It will help foreign learners bridge the gap between them and native speakers.

exercises.passage_title: How to Develop Good Study Habits
exercises.passage:
Most teenagers need to learn how to develop good study habits. Learning effective (有效的) study methods can make you feel less stressed about school and improve your grades. Here are some useful methods.

☆ Make a plan ahead of time. First, create a calendar. Use a large wall calendar and write all of your tasks and activities on it. Next, create a weekly planner (规划簿). __18__ You should make sure to include time to work on each task a few days before it's due. Then, create a daily list. This to-do list helps you to know what you should do a day and see how much progress you're making.

☆ Consider the study environment. __19__ Maybe you work better alone. Or, maybe you like to work in a group. No matter what place you choose, when it's homework time, that's the environment you should study in.

☆ __20__ It can be very distracting (使人分心的) to have to look for a pencil or a ruler in the middle of studying. Find a place where you can keep all your homework materials so you're ready to go.

☆ Keep a worry notepad (便笺). If you are easily distracted by your own thoughts, a worry notepad is a good tool for you. Instead of trying to deal with all the distracting things, you can write them down on the notepad. __21__

Good study habits don't always come easily. It takes time to develop them.

options.B: What good study habits do you have?
options.C: Make a study plan for each week.
options.D: Do you study better at school or at home?
options.E: When you finish your homework, then you can deal with the things.

guidance.时态: 一般现在时和一般将来时

First, the best way to learn a language is to use it. 首先，学习一门语言最好的方法就是使用它。
The more you practice, the fewer mistakes you will make. 你练习得越多，犯的错误就会越少。

exercises.sample_essay:
Dear Justin,
Thank you for your trust and I really understand you. Your problem is common among language learners. Here are some suggestions for you.
First, the best way to learn a language is to use it. You should try to speak Chinese with your classmates or teachers at school. Second, you can learn more about Chinese culture, which will help you to understand the language better. Third, don't be afraid of making mistakes. It's normal. The more you practice, the fewer mistakes you will make.
Try the suggestions above, and I believe you will learn Chinese well. I hope you will enjoy your stay here.
Li Hua
